the vibration analysis of MWCNT hybrid composite shell.
the development of MWCNT-based composite shell with enhanced natural frequencies and damping.
the development of a new composite structure with MWCNTs reinforcement to enhance the natural frequency and damping of the polymer composite shell.

the addition of MWNCT to the polymer composite shell can enhance the mechanical properties of the composite shell and also the fundamental frequency and damping factor.
the addition of MWNCT in the polymer composites would enhance the natural frequencies and damping characteristics of the composite shells.
the addition of MWNCTs in the polymer resin could significantly increase the mechanical characteristics and vibration damping of the polymer composites.

MWCNTs are the best choice for the enhancement of the natural frequencies and damping factor of polymer composites.

the MWCNTs can be used as a reinforcement in polymer composite structures to enhance their vibration characteristics.
